common.notAdvice: Market data is informational only and is not financial advice. Crypto is volatile — you can lose everything.
common.offlineData: Live feed unreachable — showing a cached snapshot. Prices are not real.

trade.title: Trade
trade.subtitle: Practice spot trading against live market prices.
trade.paperNotice: Paper trading: orders fill instantly at the live price using virtual NX credits. No real money, no real custody.

invest.title: Invest
invest.subtitle: Lock NX credits into fixed-term yield plans.
invest.simNotice: Simulated yield. Returns are paid from virtual credits on a fixed schedule — this is not a fund, and no real money is pooled. A real pooled product needs an investment-services licence.
invest.earlyExitWarning: Exiting before maturity forfeits all yield and charges a 2% penalty on the principal.

game.title: Arcade
game.subtitle: Provably fair mini-games on virtual credits.
game.riskNotice: These are gambling-style games played with virtual NX credits only. Never connect real funds to them: real-money betting needs a gambling licence, age/KYC checks and an audited RNG. Games are designed to lose money over time — the house edge is 3%.
game.fairnessExplain: Each round is derived from a server seed (committed in advance as a hash), your client seed and a nonce. After you rotate the seed you can re-hash the revealed server seed and confirm it matches the commitment.
game.verifyHint: SHA-256 of this seed must equal the previous commitment. It covered {{rounds}} round(s).
game.fairnessLimitation: Honest limitation: the seed is generated in your own browser here, so it proves the UI didn't change the result mid-round — it is not equivalent to a licensed operator's independently audited RNG.

predict.title: Price prediction
predict.teaser: Call the next candle — up or down
predict.subtitle: Settled on live market prices
predict.riskNotice: Short-term up/down betting on virtual credits. Real-money binary options are a regulated derivative and are banned for retail traders in the UK and EU — do not connect real funds.

earn.title: Earn
earn.subtitle: Daily rewards, quests and referrals.
earn.referralDesc: Share your code to grow your streak bonus
earn.referralNote: Referral credits are virtual. A paid referral scheme that pays real value can be treated as a financial promotion — check local rules before launching one.
earn.shareText: Join me on NEXUS — the crypto terminal mini app

quest.firstGame: Play a round in the arcade

earn.virtualNotice: All rewards are virtual NX credits used inside this app. They have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn.

wallet.noProvider: No injected wallet found. Telegram's in-app browser has no wallet provider — add TON Connect or WalletConnect v2 for production (see WalletContext.jsx).
wallet.custodyNotice: Read-only. This app has no deposit address and never asks you to send crypto anywhere. Any bot that asks you to transfer funds to it should be treated as a scam.
wallet.resetDesc: Reset your virtual balance, positions, plans and history back to the starting state.
